author: dcovingt08
quote: Game isn't anything that was reported in early reviews. Graphics are good, the gameplay feel isn't anything amazing but its not bad. It's what I expected out of them, similar to rdr/gta5 etc. Interface is solid. The storyline? Absolute dog ****. The bugs? Tons of them. No save slots? What are we doing here... Doesn't feel like an open world game where I can actually do whatever I want. Countless parts you can't shoot any randoms, can't crash into them, very restricted feeling and back to the story line... It's just bad. Not able to go back and reclaim cars previously missed is ridiculous. Not what we've come to expect from GTA, serious disappointment.
